nodes.summary: If a group $G$ acts faithfully on a set $X$ such that for any two ordered pairs of distinct points of $X$ some element of $G$ maps the first to the second, then no point stabilizer of the action is isomorphic to the infinite cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: No doubly transitive group has an infinite cyclic point stabilizer (Kourovka 10.63)

nodes.summary: The statement that there exist a group $G$ and a faithful action of $G$ on a set $X$ such that for any two ordered pairs of distinct points of $X$ some element of $G$ maps the first to the second, and the stabilizer of some point $x \in X$ is isomorphic to the infinite cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Doubly transitive group with infinite cyclic point stabilizer (Kourovka 10.63)

nodes.summary: There exist a group $G$ with an element of infinite order and a faithful action of $G$ on a set $X$ such that for any two ordered pairs of distinct points of $X$ some element of $G$ maps the first to the second, and every element of the stabilizer of some point $x \in X$ has finite order.
nodes.title: A non-periodic doubly transitive group with a periodic point stabilizer (Kourovka 10.64)

nodes.summary: The statement that there exist a group $G$ and a faithful action of $G$ on a set $X$ such that for any two ordered pairs of distinct points of $X$ some element of $G$ maps the first to the second, $G$ has an element of infinite order, and every element of the stabilizer of some point $x \in X$ has finite order.
nodes.title: Non-periodic doubly transitive group with periodic point stabilizer (Kourovka 10.64)

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
